    • addEscalation

      <E extends Throwable> ManagedFunctionEscalationTypeBuilder addEscalation(Class<E> escalationType)

      Adds a ManagedFunctionEscalationTypeBuilder to the ManagedFunctionTypeBuilder definition.

      It is possible the MethodReturnTranslator will throw an Escalation. While this should be avoided, this allows registering Escalation for being handled.

      Type Parameters:
      E - Escalation type.
      Parameters:
      escalationType - Type to be handled by an EscalationFlow.
      Returns:
      ManagedFunctionEscalationTypeBuilder to provide the type definition.
